run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate slab placements and write VASP input files
precompute_slabs: precompute slab surfaces for a given bulk index and save them to disk
write_surface: write VASP input files and metadata for a specified slab surface
parse_args: parse command line arguments for adsorbate bulk surface sampling and placement generation
run_placements: run adsorbate placement generation for a single adsorbate bulk surface index combination
